d:
Translated on my home-lab Cluster as a test translation for a local translation workflow I'm trying out,
Definitely not perfect, and I considered not uploading it,

That being said though the translation is reasonable-ish (qwen3.6 27B-Q8) and apart from some weird in-painting/font coloring issues the result is at-least "serviceable" if nothing else, I'll try to improve the flow and improve the gallery as I work out the bugs/get more familiar with the tools.

...Since I figure the chance of this getting a proper translation is near-zero, I might as well share this for the odd-soul who likes to read the story of a set so extreme (no judgement), so here we are.

Don't crucify me.
